description: This header file defines utilities for capturing and symbolizing backtraces in PyTorch's C++ codebase. It provides functions to obtain backtrace strings and lazily symbolized backtrace objects, along with type aliases and deprecated functions.

methods.name: get_backtrace
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the current call stack, with options to skip frames, limit the number of frames, and exclude Python frames. Deprecated in favor of get_lazy_backtrace.

methods.name: get_lazy_backtrace
methods.description: Returns a lazily evaluated backtrace object, which can be converted to a string only if needed, with options similar to get_backtrace.
